name: Dòideag

attributes.attribute: witch of the Isle of Mull

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Dòideag was a witch of the Isle of Mull off Scotland. Writers present her as a historical figure. Speakers blamed her, or credited her, for the destruction of the Spanish Armada when it invaded England. Control over weather of this kind is normally assigned to the hag called the Cailleach. Dòideag appears patterned on that figure. Her story shows how a local woman could take on the power of a wider mythic being.

okr.objective: Set out the account of the Scottish witch Dòideag and her link to the destruction of the Spanish Armada.
